prior_summary: Red-anchored Cartesian diffusion makes approach, grasp alignment, lift and local held-object motion invariant by construction to a chunk-level displacement of observed red, while relational destination/successor features and robot state retain transport and reachability dependencies.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when red is displaced from the demonstrated initial patch but is observed and plausibly reachable, from open approach through red release and the supervised blue-acquisition overlap.
termination_guidance: Core termination is observed red stability near the supplied buffer with open fingers and clear TCP. A later handoff remains supported through blue closure and initial lift while red stays stationary.
limitations: Not a collision or recovery controller. Stale red pose corrupts the action frame; arbitrary red shifts can make transport out of support or unreachable. Successful runs do not establish recovery after miss, drop or wrong contact.
